I5.quote: In this paper, we have demonstrated a low temperature hydrogen (H2) sensor based on reduced graphene oxide (rGO) and tin oxide nanoﬂowers (SnO2 NFs) hybrid composite ﬁlm.

notes: Chemiresistive H2 gas-sensing paper (rGO and rGO-SnO2 NFs films). H2 interaction is measured only as resistance change: 'The response of the device is deﬁned as [30], Response = (R - R o) R o ´ 100%' (main, PDF p. 5, journal p. 4, Eq. 3); 'The measurements were performed for different concentrations of H2 ranging from 200-1000 ppm' (main, PDF p. 5, journal p. 4). No H2 uptake amount, no TPD, no electrolyte charging, so the I1 failure is coded no_conditions_stated (not theoretical_only, not electrochemical). For information only (I4 not assessed): SI Figure S2 page image shows N2 single-point surface areas of 1.74 (rGO) and 5.11 (rGO-SnO2 NFs) sq.m/gm.
